entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: A message sent by the network to reject a service request from the UE.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: A message sent by the UE to request establishment of a secure connection to the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates service requests to the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The core network infrastructure that processes service requests and may send service reject messages.

relations.description: The network sends a SERVICE REJECT message in response to a SERVICE REQUEST from the UE.
The UE initiates a SERVICE REQUEST message to establish a secure connection.
The SERVICE REJECT message transitions the service request procedure to a rejected state.
